meta.title: Email OCR — Auto-Fetch from Inbox: refused for a user without the AP Executive role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the AP Executive role and attempt Email OCR — Auto-Fetch from Inbox.
Repeat Email OCR — Auto-Fetch from Inbox as an AP Executive.
Compare the two users' availability or refusal outcomes in the same Enterprise tenant.
Verify or record tenant RBAC configuration when access is deliberately granted to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the AP Executive role and attempt Email OCR — Auto-Fetch from Inbox.; Repeat Email OCR — Auto-Fetch from Inbox as an AP Executive.; Compare the two users' availability or refusal outcomes in the same Enterprise tenant.; Verify or record tenant RBAC configuration when access is deliberately granted to additional roles.

args.need: in the same Enterprise tenant, sign in first as a user without the AP Executive role and attempt Email OCR — Auto-Fetch from Inbox, then repeat as an AP Executive and report whether the action is refused, absent, or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot access the Email OCR feature or perform role-specific sign-ins, so tester interaction is required.
Provide a final observable assertion after the tester interaction, although it cannot establish the requested role-based behavior.
